phase_1_camera_stability.goal: The flight must feel like a stabilized drone/gimbal pass, not terrain-following jitter.
actions: Build a new local flight centerline in ENU from the existing WP0-WP27 route; do not move the route to new places.
Parameterize by arc length, not waypoint index/time.
Sample local terrain continuously along the route and create a constrained smooth altitude curve with target AGL 3.75 m and hard band 3.5-4.0 m.
Use cubic Catmull-Rom/Hermite/B-spline or equivalent C1/C2 continuous position interpolation. Do not use LinearApproximation for the local camera pass.
After smoothing, re-evaluate raw AGL against local terrain and correct the curve only enough to remain inside 3.5-4.0 m; never clamp telemetry values.

Camera orientation uses a 6-8 m look-ahead target along arc length and a stabilized up vector. Roll remains zero unless explicitly authored. Do not add a second fixed pitch rotation on top of a terrain-sloped direction vector.
Smooth orientation using quaternion slerp/damped gimbal logic so pitch/yaw changes are continuous.
Keep house collision clearance and add collision clearance against any retained near-camera environment geometry.
Produce a sandbox 15 s camera-only proof before adding heavy reality geometry.
acceptance: no visible vertical oscillation/bounce in the owner-visible pass
